summary: Cycurion (NASDAQ:CYCU) filed an 8-K on June 29, 2026 to disclose it had entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement on June 24 to acquire substantially all assets of Kustom Entertainment's (NASDAQ:KUST) video-solutions division, including the Digital Ally brand's in-car/body-worn cameras and evidence management. Terms were not disclosed. The acquisition provides ~1,000 clients and ~58 patents. Closing is expected in early July 2026. Cycurion's board has approved the transaction. This is a transformative bolt-on acquisition, non-dilutive per the filing. Watch for close timing and any regulatory or Nasdaq listing compliance issues.
